changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpatientinsurances AS SELECT pi.id, pi.patient_id, pi.payor_id, pi.plan_id, pi.policy_holder_id, pi.policy_number, pi.group_number, pi.expiration_date, pi.remaining_benefits, pi.remaining_deductibles, pi.is_primary, pi.created_by, pi.created_date, pi.last_modified_by, pi.last_modified_date, pi.payer_name, pi.tpa_nphies_id, pi.tpa_name, pi.member_card_id, pi.payer_nphies_id, pi.network_id, pi.sponsor_number, pi.coverage_type, pi.relation_with_subscriber, pi.policy_class_name, pi.policy_holder_name, pi.issue_date, pi.patient_share, pi.max_limit, pi.waseel_new_plan, pi.group_name, pi.plan_code, pi.eligibility_status, pi.site_eligibility, pi.inforce, pi.gp_visit_copay, pi.specialist_visits_limit, pi.eligibility_benefits_json, pi.last_eligibility_request_id, pi.last_eligibility_synced_at, pi.default_copayment_percent, pi.default_maximum_copayment, pi.benefit_start_date, pi.benefit_end_date FROM public.patient_insurances pi;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwpatientinsurances TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwpatientinsurances FROM report_user;
